title: Homo Fluxus v2.0 — A Civilization Map Through Energy-Flow Cosmology: From Grid to Governance — One Gradient, All Regimes
abstract: Systems-level map extending Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) across biology, cognition, economy, governance, and AI, defining Homo Fluxus as a dynamic entropy-gradient process rather than a static entity. v2.0 anchors the framework empirically: in human connectomes, local structure (degree ratio) predicts the functional variability gradient (κ) with r ≈ −0.97, while a global graph metric (Fiedler eigenvalue λ₂) fails (r ≈ 0.16), supporting the EFC principle that local structure governs energy/information flow.
